About Cidna

Your money, in your language and calendar, on your own phone.

On this pageWhy Cidna?Three pillarsFree and open sourceAbout the nameProviderContact channels & legal pages

Why Cidna?

Most finance apps are built for English, Gregorian-calendar, dollar-thinking users and ask for your data before they give you value. Cidna flips that: start as a guest in seconds, record in Persian or English, see Jalali dates and Toman natively, and keep your records on your own phone. Create an account only when you want multi-device sync.

Three pillars

  1. Local-first. Records live in an encrypted on-device database; use is fast and keeps working offline after sign-in.
  2. Private by design. Financial records are end-to-end encrypted on the phone before upload.
  3. Made for Persian and English speakers. RTL and LTR, Jalali calendar, Toman/Rial.

Free and open source

Cidna is completely free, with no ads or trackers. Its code is released under the GNU AGPL v3 or later; the “Cidna / سیدنا” name and logo are not licensed with it, so forks must use a different name and icon. Licenses

About the name

The product is “سیدنا” in Persian and “Cidna” in English. “Budget Management” merely describes what the app does.
